title: My weekend
text:
Hello Mark,

Thank you for your email. My weekend was great! On Saturday I was at my sister's house in the country. Her house is old and it has got a big garden with apple trees. We cooked lunch together and played games with her children. They are six and eight.

On Sunday it was cold and rainy, so I stayed at home. I watched two films and talked to my parents on the phone.

What about you? Were you at the football match on Saturday?

Write soon,
Peter
